messages:
maria_prod: Heads-up — Sales got a new enterprise ask. Fintech customer wants Dedicated capacity for embeddings + chat with predictable latency. They expect 60 steady QPS and peaks up to ~220 QPS during market opens.
sasha_sales: +1. They're asking for an SLA on p50/p95 and a hard burst guarantee for first 3 months. Pricing will be negotiated but they want firm numbers to sign.
matt_eng: Do we have a quick ballpark for GPU pools? rough calc: ~512 tokens/request avg, reqs/sec=60 steady -> tokens/s ~30720. With A100 perf we can probably do ~800 tok/s per GPU baseline (varies by model). 
anya_sre: That baseline seems optimistic for generation + embeddings mix. For safety i'd plan on 400 tok/s per GPU for mixed load + KV cache miss rates. So steady 30720/400 ~ 77 GPUs. Peak 220 QPS -> tokens/s ~112640 -> /400 ~= 282 GPUs.
maria_prod: Ok that's a large swing. Sales needs options: reserved vs burst credits. Can we propose a committed pool of ~90 GPUs + burst to 300 with autoscale policy and warm cache strategy?
matt_eng: Committed 90 GPUs seems reasonable for predictable throughput, but burst to 300 will require cross-pool routing and capacity in another AZ/region to avoid noisy-neighbor effects. Also need warm standby for hot models to hit latency SLO.
olivia_support: Customer will want a rollout checklist — migration plan, canary traffic %, fallback model, and observability retention for 90 days. Also KMS audit logs.
sasha_sales: They also flagged data residency: EU region only for production traffic. Can Dedicated Private support that?
anya_sre: Yes, we can map pool to eu-west-1 private deployment. Need a private control plane and KMS integration. That increases ops work but doable.
maria_prod: Launch criteria draft: 1) validated perf tests at target load with p95 <= 350ms; 2) autoscale triggers tested under synthetic spikes; 3) fallback policy to smaller quantized model; 4) security/compliance signoff.
matt_eng: Action items: I will run a perf sweep with mixed workload (text-gen + embeddings) by EOD Thu and post results. Anya can you estimate runbook ops cost for maintaining burst capacity?
anya_sre: Will do. I'll estimate on-call rotations and AZ capacity booking, plus KMS integration effort. ETA Fri COB.
sasha_sales: I'll prep the commercial options: 90 GPU reserved + burst pool with overage pricing, and an alternate pkg w/ 150 reserved if they want smaller burst.
maria_prod: Thanks. If perf numbers look good we'll create a scoped RFC for the Dedicated offering and include canary steps. @deploy-bot can you create a tracking ticket?
deploy-bot: Created ticket PROD-4837: "Fintech EU Dedicated - reserved 90 + burst to 300" and added initial checklist.
matt_eng: Added rough perf run notes to the ticket. Will update with numbers.
olivia_support: I'll prepare the customer-facing runbook template and share with Sales after the RFC lands.
maria_prod: Great. Meet again after perf sweep. :thumbsup:
